x_1577958_dsb_pattern.name: Emergency outreach and workforce wellbeing (Safe Workplace)
x_1577958_dsb_pattern.overview: Contactable people, pre-built outreach, automatic follow-up. (1) Keep user mobile numbers, locations (with coordinates) and managers current via the HR/identity sync. (2) Configure the OOB outreach capability (Emergency Outreach / Safe Workplace where licensed) with channels: email, SMS (Notify/Twilio), Now Mobile and Microsoft Teams. (3) Outreach templates per scenario (bushfire, flood, building evacuation, cyber) with response options. (4) Follow-up flow: "need help" creates a welfare task; non-responders get reminders then escalate to managers. (5) Crisis dashboard with live counts; restricted role for the crisis team. (6) Run a test outreach each quarter. Response data is sensitive — access limited and retention defined.
x_1577958_dsb_pattern.pain: No reliable way to reach staff in an affected area Responses tracked in spreadsheets People needing help are not followed up promptly Contact details and locations are out of date No audit trail for the crisis response
x_1577958_dsb_pattern.summary: When an emergency happens — bushfire, flood, cyber event, pandemic — the organisation cannot quickly reach affected staff, confirm they are safe, and coordinate help. Contact lists are out of date, responses come back by email and text, and follow-up is manual. The pattern converges on OOB Emergency Outreach / Safe Workplace capabilities where licensed (or a governed outreach flow): targeted outreach by location or group through email, SMS, mobile and Teams, response tracking, automatic follow-up tasks for people who need help, and dashboards for the crisis team.
